10489.explanation:

"So then let us not sleep, as others do, but let us keep awake and be sober."(1 Thessalonians 5:6, RSV)

10495.subject: Christian Religious Knowledge (CRK)
10495.question_text: According to James, Christians should avoid partiality so that they would not be
10495.explanation:
In James 2:8-9 (RSV), James warns against showing partiality because it goes against the "royal law" of loving one's neighbour. He states:

"If you really fulfil the royal law, according to the scripture, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself,’ you do well. But if you show partiality, you commit sin, and are convicted by the law as transgressors."

This means that showing favouritism or discrimination makes a Christian guilty of breaking God's law. Therefore, Christians should treat all people fairly to remain obedient to God's commandments.

10498.question_text: According to Paul, the generosity of a giver will produce
10498.explanation:
According to Paul, the generosity of a giver will produce thanksgiving to God. Paul emphasises that when believers are generous, it leads to others thanking God for the blessings they receive. This highlights how acts of generosity can inspire gratitude and worship to God.

Biblical Reference (2 Corinthians 9:11-12, RSV):

"You will be enriched in every way for great generosity, which through us will produce thanksgiving to God; for the rendering of this service not only supplies the needs of the saints but also overflows in many thanksgivings to God."

In this passage, Paul is explaining how the generosity of the givers leads to thanksgiving from those who benefit from their generosity.
